# CLODEX Check

> CLODEX Check (https://check.clodex.xyz) is an open-source (AGPL-3.0) AI API authenticity, protocol, and streaming auditor for Claude, OpenAI (GPT), and Gemini endpoints.
> In 60–80 seconds it runs up to 17 detectors to prove whether an AI API proxy or gateway truly serves the genuine model or silently substitutes a cheaper backend, truncates context, disables Prompt Caching, injects hidden system prompts, or buffers fake streams.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://check.clodex.xyz/): Protocol hub and feature overview (RU / EN / ZH).
- [Claude API Authenticity Check](https://check.clodex.xyz/claude): 17 detectors for Anthropic Messages API (`/v1/messages`), anchored by Anthropic server-side `thinking signature` cryptographic verification, Prompt Caching, hidden system-prompt audit, dynamic PNG vision, anti-cache reasoning, Pelican SVG visual benchmark, and true streaming `tok/s`.
- [OpenAI / GPT API Check](https://check.clodex.xyz/openai): 14 detectors for OpenAI Chat Completions (`/v1/chat/completions`), including `o200k_base` tokenizer probe, Prompt Caching, system-prompt audit, dynamic PNG vision, anti-cache reasoning, Pelican SVG benchmark, strict JSON Schema, function calling, true streaming `tok/s`, and cross-vendor usage fingerprint detection.
- [Gemini API Check](https://check.clodex.xyz/gemini): 12 detectors for Gemini OpenAI-compatible endpoints including SentencePiece tokenizer probe, dynamic PNG vision, anti-cache reasoning, system-prompt audit, Pelican SVG, function calling, JSON Schema, and true streaming `tok/s`.
- [Pelican-on-a-Bicycle SVG Benchmark](https://check.clodex.xyz/pelican): Standalone Simon Willison visual SVG benchmark for Claude, OpenAI, and Gemini (1 streamed call, live sanitized SVG preview, TTFT, live `tok/s`, and buffered-stream check).
- [Side-by-Side Provider Comparison](https://check.clodex.xyz/compare): Compare any two `/r/{id}` reports side by side — score delta, TTFT, live `tok/s`, detector-by-detector diff matrix, and two Pelican SVGs side by side.
- [FAQ](https://check.clodex.xyz/faq): Practical and technical answers on authenticity checks, thinking signatures, Pelican SVG, Prompt Caching, streaming, privacy, and self-hosting.
- [Full Technical Reference for LLMs](https://check.clodex.xyz/llms-full.txt): Complete detector weights, methodology, API surface, and security model.

## Privacy & Security

- Zero-key-persistence: API keys live strictly in RAM during a check run and are discarded immediately afterward.
- Raw keys are never written to disk, logs, report JSON, or databases; public reports contain only a masked prefix/suffix.
- Model-generated SVGs are strictly sanitized (stripping `<script>`, `<foreignObject>`, event handlers, `<!DOCTYPE>`/`<!ENTITY>`) and downloaded with `Content-Security-Policy: sandbox`.
- 100% open source under AGPL-3.0 at https://github.com/mereyabdenbekuly-ctrl/check (Docker / Python / CLI self-hosting).
